subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

The symbols were __useless__ to him.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (1)** i.e. **'worthless'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Useless: **(अनुपयोगी) having no value or purpose.

 
 
• **Example: **He has two old smartphones which are totally **useless**.
 
 
 
• **Worthless:** (किसी काम का नहीं) having no value or being of very low value.
 
 
• **Example: **His promises were **worthless.**
 
 
 
• From the above examples it is clear that '**Useless' **and '**Worthless'** are similar to each other.

*Therefore, the correct answer is '**worthless'.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Successful: **(सफल) achieving a desired outcome or goal.
 
• **Valuable: **(मूल्यवान) having great worth or importance.
 
• **Reachable: **(पहुँचने योग्य) capable of being reached or accessed.
